summary: VS-030 research compendium provides comprehensive evaluation of BasicMultiplayer for private family sessions. Document thoroughly analyzes Godot version compatibility, license provenance, networking authority models, save synchronization, and child-safety requirements. Clear recommendation with implementation roadmap and risk assessment.

strengths.description: Exceptionally thorough analysis of BasicMultiplayer addon covering Godot version compatibility (4.0+ with 4.6 verification), MIT license provenance, networking authority models, and save synchronization implications.
Strong emphasis on child safety with COPPA compliance analysis, parent authorization requirements, private-invite only model, and no unmoderated public discovery or chat.
Definitive decision: BasicMultiplayer APPROVED WITH SAFETY WRAPPER. Includes 8 specific conditions for safe integration (ChoyceMultiplayer wrapper, parent gate, private invites, etc.).
Detailed 5-phase implementation roadmap from foundation to documentation with clear timelines and deliverables.
Complete risk matrix covering COPPA violation, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, save corruption, connection failures, and cheating with mitigation strategies.
Well-designed ChoyceMultiplayer wrapper architecture with host-authoritative model, parent as server, and optional dependency splitting.
Comprehensive safety features including COPPA compliance manager, audit logging, content filtering, privacy protection, and session timeout handling.
Complete automated test suite plan covering authority models, save/load scenarios, invite system, safety features, and performance.
Analysis of multiple alternatives (GD-Sync, Easy Peasy Multiplayer, GodotHighLevelMultiplayer, Coly, Nakama) with verdicts and recommendations.

suggestions.description: Consider starting with Phase 1 (Foundation) as soon as VS-026 and TASK-045 dependencies are complete.
Add a quick-start guide at the top for developers implementing the multiplayer wrapper.

notes: BasicMultiplayer is MIT licensed and Godot 4.6 compatible.
Recommendation is to use BasicMultiplayer with a ChoyceMultiplayer safety wrapper.
8 conditions must be met: safety wrapper, parent authorization gate, private invite system, disabled chat, optional dependency, host-authoritative model, automated test suite.
Implementation roadmap spans 5 phases over 5 weeks.
Risk assessment covers all critical safety and technical concerns.
Success criteria ensure multiplayer is opt-in, parent-consented, private, child-safe, and tested.
Importantly: NO multiplayer runtime dependency will be added to the single-player visual vertical slice.
The document provides extensive references to Godot multiplayer docs, COPPA compliance, and networking best practices.

decision.reason: Comprehensive evaluation of BasicMultiplayer with clear approval recommendation, implementation roadmap, safety requirements, and risk assessment. All acceptance criteria met. Ready for implementation.
